Class LobbyServer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.network.server.LobbyServer
public class LobbyServer extends Object
TCP lobby server.

Accepts incoming Socket connections and routes each player to the appropriate GameSession. The RmiServerImpl delegates nickname management here so that Socket and RMI players share a single authority on unique nicknames — eliminating the collision bug where an RMI player could join with the same name as an already-connected Socket player.

The lobby holds a (possibly null) LeaderboardRepository provided by GameServer and forwards it to every new GameSession; sessions use it to persist game results and serve end-of-game rankings (DB leaderboard feature).

      public static final String NEW_SESSION
